sensevoice.role: Speech recognition for internal quality checks only; nothing from this model is in the film
sensevoice.model: SenseVoice-small int8 (zh/en/ja/ko/yue) 2024-07-17, ONNX export by sherpa-onnx

runtime.environment: .venv-voice (python -m venv, then pip install sherpa-onnx numpy)

not_used: macOS system voices (Tingting, Eddy, Reed, ...): Apple's licence restricts system voices to personal, non-commercial use.
